input: A task related to this domain that needs expert judgment

without_kdna.expected_approach: How an equally capable agent answers without this domain. It may reach the same conclusion; write 'unspecified' when no baseline answer was actually observed.
without_kdna.common_mistake: A known failure mode of the unloaded answer, if one was observed. Do not preset one: an equally correct answer is a normal result.

with_kdna.expected_approach: How this domain's declared judgment applies to the input. It may match the unloaded answer and still be a correct result.
with_kdna.signal_reading: Which domain signal this input triggers

trigger: keyword or pattern that activates this domain
